label: Rhea system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Rhea locus that can restrict bacteriophage infection.
observations: Rhea branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Rhea genes, Rhea proteins, DefenseFinder article-registry rows, source-database rows naming one Rhea locus, unresolved Rhea triggers or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
